thread:
emma: flagging SolarFlux POC — rerank endpoint failing with dim mismatch and intermittent rate limits. dumping logs.

kyle: paste the raw requests and the model pins pls.

dani: client flow: call /v1/embeddings with model "embed-pro-1024" -> arrays len 1024 -> then POST to /v1/rerank pinned to "rerank-prod-1536" -> 400 embedding_dim_mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024

dani: small snippet:
````
POST /v1/embeddings { model: "embed-pro-1024", input: [...] }
-> embeddings: [[...1024 floats...]]
POST /v1/rerank { model: "rerank-prod-1536", documents: [[...1024 floats...]] }
-> 400 embedding_dim_mismatch
````

priya: that's a model mismatch. Two options: change encoder to 1536 model or re-pin rerank to a 1024-compatible variant. For demo, swap encoder is faster.

emma: cost question — how much more to run 1536 model for ~10k docs?

security-bot: note: embed-large-1536 ~2.2x cost vs embed-pro-1024. For POCs we can issue a one-off $125 credit. Reach out to billing.

kyle: also saw 429s when they batch ~180 docs. log: `429 RateLimit: batch_items_exceeded (max_batch=64)`

priya: hosted soft limit for large models is ~64 items/request. Recommend client batch <=40 for stability or enable streaming batching.

dani: what's your recommended retry/backoff? their current retry is immediate which spikes errors.

priya: exponential backoff + jitter. suggested: initial=150ms, multiplier=2, max=4s, full jitter. add Idempotency-Key header for retries.

kyle: added preflight check to assert vector length and fail early. snippet: `if (vec.length !== EXPECTED) throw new Error('vec dim')`

emma: is there a server-side auto-projection from 1024->1536? would save demos.

priya: we don't auto-project by default for quality reasons. can offer an opt-in compatibility shim for POCs (learned linear map) but requires ops approval and may affect ranking fidelity.

security-bot: quick on logs: embeddings are considered customer data; default trial retention 14 days, vectors redacted in standard access logs. We can shorten retention or disable logging for the account on request.

dani: after switching encoder to embed-large-1536 and reducing batch_size to 40, rerank calls passed in staging. no dim errors; 429s dropped.

ops-bot: Deployment note: Dedicated capacity request for solarflux-poc queued (dc-5013). ETA ~1hr.

emma: follow-ups: 1) add client-side dim check and 429 metric; 2) apply backoff/jitter as above; 3) billing to confirm credit — thanks team.

kyle: closing when billing confirms credit. ping if anything else crops up.
